name: Public-repo guard (secrets + content policy)
description: Blocking pre-publication gate for WAVE public repos. Runs gitleaks for formatted secrets plus the WAVE content-policy script for the things gitleaks misses: live Stripe account IDs, hardcoded Cloudflare account_ids, developer absolute paths, private-repo references, and committed .env files. Rules are pulled from the canonical source (wave-av/.github). Install on every public repo.
